text: Underway in the terracotta and teal!
Tortoise immediately communicates the plan across the centre circle, looking to anchor the terracotta defensive line.
Griezmatronn breaks clean through the middle, right on goal!
A fortunate escape as the magenta ball rolls harmlessly wide.
Robodinho bundles it in from point-blank range! It's an early lead for Synthetic Athletic, making it AFC Fable nil, Synthetic Athletic one!
Tortoise marches steadily upfield towards the attacking third.
Tortoise flashes an effort inches wide of the upright!
Another golden chance goes begging right in front of the net!
Terracotta shirts applying all the pressure here, penning Synthetic Athletic back against their own goal line.
Robodinho relieves that siege with a strong run up the right flank into midfield.
Hare calls to drop back.
Robodinho charges down the left!
It's Robodinho again! A sharp strike from the left channel doubles the teal advantage! AFC Fable nil, Synthetic Athletic two!
Tortoise pulls one back from close range! Fable are right back in this contest, it is AFC Fable one, Synthetic Athletic two!
Hare loses footing and hits the deck.
Fable teammates collide in a heap!
Hare recovers quickly and crunches into Robodinho, sending the teal striker crashing down to the surface.
The corner push-panel launches it out!
Hare picks up the rebound and is clean through with nobody in the way!
Fable maintain relentless pressure in the final third, probing for an equaliser.
A total mix-up as the Synthetic Athletic pair crash together!
Robodinho levels Hare out wide!
Another powered panel triggers, firing the ball clear.
Hare flies into a robust challenge, flattening Robodinho in the teal half!
Hare clatters into Griezmatronn too!
Hare tumbles over the ball!
Hare scrambles it home! What chaos! It's AFC Fable two, Synthetic Athletic two!
Hare signals celebrating that lightning finish, urging Fable to keep up this brisk attacking rhythm.

A brief pause as the actuators cool. Synthetic Athletic came into today hungry for points after that agonizing 4-3 defeat to Real Machina, but Fable's relentless pressing has completely reset the dynamic.
Griezmatronn storms seven metres down the left wall.
Griezmatronn is through on goal, four metres out and looking to restore the teal lead!
Hare broadcasts a sharp message across the terracotta backline, staying alert and claiming defensive responsibility.
Robodinho strikes again with thirty seconds until the interval! A clinical finish from the right makes it AFC Fable two, Synthetic Athletic three!
Robodinho surges forward through the middle!
Robodinho grabs a hat-trick right on the stroke of half-time! Ruthless finishing from point-blank range, and Synthetic Athletic extend their lead to four goals to two!
Hare rallies the terracotta unit.
The buzzer sounds for half-time! Six goals in an utterly breathless opening period, and Synthetic Athletic lead AFC Fable four goals to two.
Tortoise powers right through the centre!
Instant response from Tortoise! A pinpoint finish into the net cuts the deficit to just one! AFC Fable three, Synthetic Athletic four!
Tortoise spots the opening from the halfway line and is clear through on goal!
Agonisingly close! Shaving the paint off the frame!
Another point-blank effort goes begging for Fable! They are knocking on the door with under four minutes left.
Tortoise signals for calm, steady progression out from the left touchline.
A brief lull with just over three minutes left. Fable trailing by one, having shown tremendous grit after falling behind before the break.
Fable let fly from the left channel, but it whistles just wide of the target!
Robodinho calls to use the rebound boards.
Fable suffocating the teal defence!
A deflection almost sneaks in at the near post!
Rebounded hard off the corner panel!
Teal teammates clash heavily again!
Griezmatronn takes down Hare!
Tortoise sweeps it into the open net! We are level again with under two and a half minutes remaining! AFC Fable four, Synthetic Athletic four!
Synthetic Athletic mount a desperate siege in the Fable third.
Disaster for Fable! Hare turns it into the wrong net under heavy pressure! An own goal puts Synthetic Athletic ahead, four to five!
Griezmatronn takes an unforced tumble.
Robodinho stops Tortoise in midfield with a bruising collision as the clock ticks under one-forty.
Hare breaks clear down the left wing!
Hare drives toward the goalmouth!
Hare stumbles right on cue!
Robodinho alerts Griezmatronn to contest the loose ball tight against the barrier.
Hare scrambles up and stabs it over the line! Redemption in the blink of an eye! We are tied at five apiece entering the final minute!
Inches from a winner! The ball kisses the post and bounces clear as fifty seconds remain!
Unbelievable scenes! Griezmatronn deflects it into the teal goal! Another own goal in this wild season, and Fable lead six to five with forty seconds left!
Robodinho drives straight down the middle!
Would you believe it! Tortoise inadvertently knocks it home! Three own goals today, and Synthetic Athletic have levelled it at six all in the dying seconds!
Robodinho scores with one second left! Utter heartbreak! Six to seven!
Full-time: AFC Fable six, Synthetic Athletic seven. Next up: Gemini Flash versus Manus FC at twelve.
